$comment: Budgets for the tx402 core import path. Authority: ADR-008.
ownCodeGzipBytes is RELEASE-BLOCKING. It measures only the code tx402 itself emits,
treating @x402/core, zod, and every chain adapter as external. 25 KiB = 25600 bytes.
totalCorePathGzipBytes was amended at M2 from a 25.79 KiB measured baseline.
The enforced 28 KiB ceiling permits 8.6% headroom; authority is the M2 amendment
in ADR-008. The independent own-code limit remains unchanged.
Chain adapters (tx402/evm, tx402/solana) are measured and reported separately and are
excluded from both figures, consistent with the SPEC §12.3 carve-out.
